Class Steady

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Steady
public final class Steady extends Object
Keeps scrolling lists where the player left them (API version 36). A page that clears a list and draws it again on every click takes a player who scrolled down back to the top; the game has no way to set a scroll position. Steady looks at what the page is about to send and keeps the rows that did not change: a row whose template and click data are the same as last time stays (its texts are still set), and only the rows from the first one that changed are taken out and drawn again. A new row at the end is only added, a row gone from the end only taken out. Lists inside a kept row are drawn again on their own. 
private final Steady steady = new Steady("#List", "#Prizes");   // the page's scrolling lists
...
steady.apply(cmd, events);          // just before sendUpdate (and in build, which records the first draw)
sendUpdate(cmd, events, false);
A row is the same when it is appended from the same file and its click bindings carry the same data, so a kept row's buttons still do what they did. A page that clears a list without drawing it again, or appends to it without clearing it, is left as it is (Steady forgets that list and the next full draw starts it again).
